FINDING (high, correctness): `validate_command_tokens` accepts invalid commands the real CLI refuses. Evidence: [command_validation.py]($HOME/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/command_validation.py:153) accepts bare `resume <plan>`, but [cli.py]($HOME/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py:556) refuses it unless `--gate` or `--all` is present; it also accepts `approve <plan> pre_resume_after_child` without `--child`, while [cli.py]($HOME/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py:245) routes that gate to a parser where `--child` is required. Recommendation: model these semantic command shapes, including required/mutually-exclusive flags and gate-specific requirements.
